nonEquivalentMappings.reason: Workbench reports residual OPD after fitting a reference sphere to the traced wavefront. Zemax Wavefront Map uses the wavelength reference sphere; Zemax Best Fit Sphere data is a surface-sag/manufacturing analysis, not a Wavefront Map reference option.

Workbench uses Optiland's centroid-sphere fit as the reference surface. Zemax Wavefront Map keeps the wavelength reference sphere; its Remove Tilt option only removes linear X and Y tilt (centroid-referenced OPD). The two analyses therefore do not report the same physical quantity.

method.curves: Current Workbench values and the captured Zemax data are paired by the tracked physical-series mapping and resampled to 257 normalized scan points.
method.grids: Current and captured grids are resampled to one shape; eight axis orientations are checked and the selected orientation is recorded.
method.semanticMapping: A numerical result is emitted only when the Workbench and Zemax analyses represent the same physical quantity. Name similarity alone is not sufficient.
